3532-5078-6604-8346.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Clinquant Skymage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

339-677-7272-8201.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
339-677-7272-8201.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing Jegantha, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2790-4836-6721.easyPrerequisites:
Angel of Destiny doesn't have summoning sickness.
Your life total is equal to or greater than 55 minus 4 for each opponent you have.
2790-4836-6721.notablePrerequisites:
Opponents cannot block creatures you control.
You control your commander.
2790-4836-6721.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Ironwill Forger triggers, giving Angel of Destiny myriad until end of turn.
Declare Angel of Destiny as an attacker. Its myriad ability triggers, creating a tapped and attacking copy of Angel of Destiny attacking each other opponent.
Deal combat damage with Angel of Destiny, causing each Angel of Destiny to trigger, causing you to gain 4 life for each Angel of Destiny and causing each opponent to gain 4 life.
Move to your end step. The Angel of Destiny tokens won't be exiled due to The Master.
At the beginning of your end step, each Angel of Destiny triggers, causing each opponent they dealt combat damage to to lose the game.

141-997-5100.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-997-5100.description:
Cast Return Upon the Tide by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Return Upon the Tide.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Naru Meha, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Return Upon the Tide
Resolve the Return Upon the Tide copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

833-1059-3756-3827.notablePrerequisites: Soul of Windgrace, Grand Warlord Radha, and at least three additional creatures you control can attack without taking damage.
833-1059-3756-3827.description:
Declare Grand Warlord Radha and Soul of Windgrace as attackers.
When they attack, Grand Warlord Radha and Soul of Windgrace trigger.
Resolve the Grand Warlord Radha trigger, adding at least five mana that you will not lose this turn as steps and phases end.
Resolve the Soul of Windgrace trigger, returning Izzet Boilerworks from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
In your next main phase, cast Waves of Aggression from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {3}{R/W}{R/W} and discarding Izzet Boilerworks, causing you to untap all creatures that attacked this turn, and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

824-2728-5256-6854.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Leech Bonder is tapped and does not have summoning sickness.
824-2728-5256-6854.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
824-2728-5256-6854.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Leech Bonder's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Host of the Hereafter and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 4.

2348-4019-5234--85--172.description:
Play the land that taps for multiple mana.
That land enters as a creature due to Nature's Revolt, triggering Vigean Graftmage's Graft ability, allowing you to move a +1/+1 counter from Vigean Graftmage to that land.
Activate that land by tapping it, adding at least two mana.
Heartbeat of Spring triggers, adding at least one additional mana.
Activate Vigean Graftmage by paying {1}{U}, untapping the land creature.
Repeat.
2348-4019-5234--85--172.notes:
Note that either the land or the additional mana source must add blue mana.

If the land adds at least {2}{U}, the additional mana source is not necessary.

You may wait a turn after playing the land instead of using the haste enabler.

2438-3234-3946-7776.description:
While Glacial Chasm is on the battlefield, all damage that would be dealt to you is prevented.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Glacial Chasm triggers. Choose not to pay its cumulative upkeep cost and sacrifice it.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, its second ability triggers, returning Glacial Chasm and Mortuary Mire from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Glacial Chasm and Mortuary Mire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Glacial Chasm trigger, sacrificing Mortuary Mire.
Resolve the Mortuary Mire trigger, putting World Shaper from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 3.
Move to your next turn, drawing World Shaper during your draw step.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Glacial Chasm triggers. Choose not to pay its cumulative upkeep cost and sacrifice it.
Cast World Shaper by paying {3}{G}.
Repeat from step 3.
2438-3234-3946-7776.notes: If your life total allows, you can instead opt to pay Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep cost. If you do this, you can forego doing this loop during that turn.

1116-2511-2946-4871.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
1116-2511-2946-4871.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Sek'Kuar trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

When Nearheath Stalker dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Nearheath Stalker
When Nearheath Stalker dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Nearheath Stalker enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.
2180-5686-6972.notes: If Nearheath Stalker starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

Resolve the spell from step 2.
Repeat.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {1}.
Repeat.

Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
You control nine or fewer lands.

Cast Budoka Gardener by paying {1}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Budoka Gardener spell three times.
Resolve the first Budoka Gardener copy.
Activate the Budoka Gardener token by tapping it, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
Arid Archway enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

Cast Aang, the Last Airbender from exile by paying {0}.

General Kreat triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, General Kreat triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-6096-6965.notes: After the first loop, General Kreat doesn't have to attack, since the Goblin token attacking will trigger it.

Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Shield Sphere
When Shield Sphere dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Shield Sphere from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Shield Sphere from the top of your library by paying 0 life.

When Carrion Feeder dies, Mortuary and Carmen trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Carrion Feeder from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Carrion Feeder from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1940-3490-4050-6822.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1940-3490-4050-6822.description:
Draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
When the Servo dies, Liliana, Dreadhorde General triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

654-5411-5531-6621.easyPrerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
654-5411-5531-6621.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Repeat.

488-641-1414-4211-4986.notablePrerequisites: One of either Lotus Petal or Tormod's Crypt must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
488-641-1414-4211-4986.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Kroxa from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Kroxa enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities and Loran trigger.
Resolve the first Kroxa trigger, sacrificing it.
Resolve the second Kroxa trigger, causing each opponent to discard a card and lose 3 life if they didn't discard a nonland card.
Resolve the Loran trigger, returning the other {0} cost artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Activate the {0} cost artifact by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

465-3742-4068-4251-5929.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Mountain.
Leyline of Transformation on the battlefield with "Samurai" chosen.
465-3742-4068-4251-5929.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

2793-3743-4094-5089-5636.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
2793-3743-4094-5089-5636.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.

Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Activate Kaya's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, giving creatures you control deathtouch until end of turn and putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature token you control.
Repeat from step 4 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Psychic Frog by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

224-1006-6133.notablePrerequisites:
Avenging Druid does not have summoning sickness.
Wolfhunter's Quiver attached to Avenging Druid.
224-1006-6133.description:
Activate Avenging Druid by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Avenging Druid triggers, causing you to reveal a land card from your library and put it onto the battlefield, and put all other cards revealed this way into your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Avenging Druid.
Repeat until no lands remain in your library and/or your library is empty.

575-4050-5623.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Pyrotechnic Performer, adding {R}.
When Pyrotechnic Performer dies, Yedora triggers, returning Pyrotechnic Performer from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Activate Pyrotechnic Performer by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Pyrotechnic Performer's disguise ability by paying {R}, turning it face-up.
Pyrotechnic Performer triggers, dealing damage equal to its power to each opponent.
Repeat.

Activate Spirit Mirror by paying {0}, destroying target creature an opponent controls, as it will be a Reflection due to the opponent's Maskwood Nexus.
Repeat step 2 as desired.
You may also repeat step 2 whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

2932-3054-4871-5147.notablePrerequisites: You have gained life this turn if Oathsworn Vampire is in your graveyard.
2932-3054-4871-5147.description:
Cast Oathsworn Vampire either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {B} due to Bontu's Monument.
Bontu's Monument triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire.
When Oathsworn Vampire dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2034-2946-3537.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Cult Conscript, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Bog Initiate by paying {1}, adding {B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard.

Ajani's Pridemate triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.

Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing two Phyrexian Mites, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.

Aetherflux Reservoir and K'rrik triggers.

Resolve the K'rrik trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite life, you may use it to activate Aetherflux Reservoir's ability to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

Archive Haunt enters the battlefield as a copy of Composite Golem.
Activate Archive Haunt by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.

Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating a token copy of Cogwork Assembler with haste.
The token copy of Cogwork Assembler enters the battlefield triggering Mana Echoes, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating a token copy of Cogwork Assembler with haste.
The token copy of Cogwork Assembler enters the battlefield triggering Mana Echoes, adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat from step seven.

306-2104-2556.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Cast Mnemonic Wall by paying {4}{U}.
Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
At the beginning of your next upkeep in your extra turn, Cache Raiders triggers, returning Mnemonic Wall from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

Holding priority, activate Nivix Guildmage's second ability by paying {2}{U}{R}, copying Channel the Suns.
Resolve the copy of Channel the Suns, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.

651-928-4046.description:
Activate Outrider en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting Task Force.
Task Force triggers, giving itself +0/+3 until end of turn.
Resolve Outrider en-Kor's ability, causing the next one damage dealt to Outrider en-Kor this turn to be dealt to Task Force instead.
